metadata.host_selection_rule: storage-only: direct child contract with most references; lexical canonical-id tie-break

semantics.runtime_rule: Structure Projector is not an AIGMos runtime component or authority.
semantics.input_rule: Consumes canonical Contract Format 1.4 JSON/graph semantics through explicit source refs.
semantics.projection_rule: 2D/3D views, layouts, forces, depth limits and presets are projection configuration only.
semantics.parameter_rule: Projection parameters may be user-adjustable and reusable as presets.
semantics.recursion_rule: View depth may be bounded for visualization while canonical recursion remains intact.
semantics.canonical_view_rule: A canonical projection preset may exist, but the projector must not invent missing children/relations.
semantics.failure_rule: Invalid/unresolved canonical input is reported rather than guessed or normalized into invented structure.

invariants.rule: Documentation, diagrams, serializers and projection tools derive from canonical semantics and never become semantic authority by convenience.

hard_gates.condition: visual layout writes back canonical structure
projection depth truncation treated as canonical absence
projector invents children/relations to repair source
invalid canonical source accepted via hidden heuristic
projector-specific representation becomes canonical source of truth

references.purpose: Projector is a derived read-only projection tool.
Visualization depth does not change canonical recursion.
